name: Dhaka Metropolitan Police official site (dmp.gov.bd)
attribution: Dhaka Metropolitan Police (dmp.gov.bd); Deputy Commissioner's office, Dhaka (dhaka.gov.bd)
notes: dmp.gov.bd is a WordPress site (pages carry no update date). Thanas = the 49 stations of "Find Your Local Police" + Hatirjheel from the Dhaka DC portal list (50, as DMP's history states). DMP covers both Dhaka city corporations, but no official source places the individual thanas in DNCC or DSCC, so no thana carries a city corporation. Phone numbers are in DHAKA_METRO_POLICE_THANAS_2026.
